items.title: Luther Henderson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Carter… [INTERVIEWEE] Carter G. Woodson. Carter G. Woodson was one of the great ones.

ctx.x: One of the big ones, Woodard … What's the great history?

Carter G. Woodson. Carter G. Woodson was one of the great ones. And of course … I know that, as I said, W.E.B. DuBois who had the crisis and so forth … uh … there was an Adam Powell Sr. (chuckles), contrary to popular opinion, Adam Powell Jr. just didn't, didn't come on the scene, and my mother was very much involved in that area. Who are the other people. There were other people involved. You know when you're a kid, you sometimes don't, it's only in retrospect that you kind of remember the people were that who…
